description: This Java class defines a BroadcastReceiver (MyReceiver) for an Android app, handling actions such as locale changes and pin request acceptance, and providing a method to generate a PendingIntent for these actions.

classes.name: MyReceiver
classes.description: An Android BroadcastReceiver handling specific broadcast intents such as locale changes and pin request acceptance, with a utility method for creating a PendingIntent.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast intents, refreshes shortcuts on locale change, shows toast and refreshes app state on pin request acceptance.

methods.name: getPinRequestAcceptedIntent
methods.description: Creates and returns a PendingIntent that triggers the receiver with a custom action indicating a pin request was accepted.
